proof_body:
by
  classical
  intro Ω ι _ _ _ I A B k hk hB hn hd hc
  have h : (Fintype.card Ω : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hb : (B.card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hB.card_ne_zero
  have hak : ((A k).card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (hn k hk).card_ne_zero
  have hu : B = I.biUnion (fun i => A i ∩ B) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Finset.mem_biUnion, Finset.mem_inter]
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩ := hc x
      exact ⟨i, hi, hxi, hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨i, _, _, hx⟩
      exact hx
  have hd' : ∀ i ∈ I, ∀ j ∈ I, i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i ∩ B) (A j ∩ B) := fun i hi j hj hij =>
    Finset.disjoint_of_subset_left Finset.inter_subset_left (Finset.disjoint_of_subset_right Finset.inter_subset_left (hd i hi j hj hij))
  have hcard : (B.card : ℝ) = ∑ i ∈ I, ((A i ∩ B).card : ℝ) := by
    conv_lhs => rw [hu, Finset.card_biUnion hd']
    push_cast
    rfl
  have hs : ∑ i ∈ I, (((A i).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) * (((A i ∩ B).card : ℝ) / (A i).card) = (B.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω := by
    rw [hcard, Finset.sum_div]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i hi => ?_
    have ha : ((A i).card : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (hn i hi).card_ne_zero
    rw [div_mul_div_comm, mul_comm ((A i).card : ℝ), mul_div_mul_right _ _ ha]
  rw [hs]
  clear hs hcard hd' hu
  field_simp
target_source: ∀ (Ω ι : Type*) [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω] (I : Finset ι) (A : ι → Finset Ω) (B : Finset Ω) (k : ι), k ∈ I → B.Nonempty → (∀ i ∈ I, (A i).Nonempty) → (∀ i ∈ I, ∀ j ∈ I, i ≠ j → Disjoint (A i) (A j)) → (∀ ω : Ω, ∃ i ∈ I, ω ∈ A i) → ((A k ∩ B).card : ℝ) / B.card = (((A k).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω * (((A k ∩ B).card : ℝ) / (A k).card)) / ∑ i ∈ I, (((A i).card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω) * (((A i ∩ B).card : ℝ) / (A i).card)
